title: Software maintenance after launch: what it costs and why it matters

points.heading: Maintenance isn't just fixing bugs
points.body: When people hear "maintenance" they think of bug fixes.

points.heading: Why "we'll just leave it alone" doesn't work
points.body: The most common assumption I hear: "Once it's built and working, we don't need to touch it." It sounds reasonable.

points.heading: What maintenance actually costs
points.body: There are two separate cost lines: hosting and maintenance.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
